snippet.title: Victory Banner — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Victory Banner is a dynamic real-time strategy game featuring direct control of any unit — from infantry soldiers to armored vehicles. The first missions of the game explore key events of the early stage of World War II.
Wishlist the game on Steam and follow for updates: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581910/Victory_Banner/
